      Fun scores

        How these were made

        I created the instrumentals for this. Each MELOSCOOP karaoke starts as a rebuilt instrumental, then the lyrics are timed word by word so you can follow along and sing in sync — just like the videos on the channel.

        1. InstrumentalA fresh instrumental is made for every song, so there's no original vocal underneath.
        2. Lyric timingLyrics are synced word by word in karaoke style, so the line lights up as you sing it.
        3. Sing alongPunch in a song number, reserve your songs, hit Play and Next on the big screen, and sing it your way.
